title: Create booking (checkout hand-off) — structuredContent
description: The `structuredContent` of the `create_booking` MCP tool: a summary of the rooms about to be booked, re-checked for availability, for the T-08 inline card (Figma MVP 1630:50627 several rooms, 1630:50749 one room) and the discoverasr.com checkout link the widget builds from it (README, 'Checkout link'). Built from the same upstream call as get_room_rate_details (README decision 3): each room's rate is a T-04 0.4.0 rate. Nothing is reserved, held or paid (PRD AC-08). 0.1.0, provisional (2026-10-28).

property_code.description: The input's `propertyCode` echoed. The checkout link's `hotel`.

property_name.description: The ENGLISH property name, as T-04. The card title and the checkout link's `searchdest`.

brand_code.description: As T-04: the upstream `brand` slug verbatim. Picks the card's brand panel colour.

asset_base_url.description: As T-01 to T-07: the origin relative image paths resolve against; default https://www.discoverasr.com.

address.description: PRD `address` ← upstream property `address`, verbatim, e.g. "2 Finlayson Green, Singapore 049247". The card's location line. Optional.

banner_image_url.description: PRD hero image ← upstream property `bannerImageMobile`. The card's photo; without it the widget uses the first room's photo, then a placeholder (EC-07). Optional.

checkin_date.description: The stay booked, after server defaults. The checkout link's `arrive`.

checkout_date.description: The checkout link's `depart`. The widget counts the nights from the two dates.

noOfRooms.description: The number of rooms booked: the length of `rooms`. The checkout link's `rooms`.

noOfadults.description: The adults of all rooms together. The card's guest line.

noOfchildren.description: The children of all rooms together.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of EVERY price in the response (AC-07).

resolution.description: PRD `resolution_method`: "selected" when every room came with `roomCode` + `ratePlanCode`, "cheapest" when the server picked every one (AC-02), "mixed" otherwise. For the model: it says when it chose the room for the user.

total_stay_price.description: "Rooms total": the whole stay of every room INCLUDING taxes, in `currency`: the sum of each rate's `total_stay_rate`, plus its `total_tax` when `is_tax_inclusive` is false (README decision 3). So the model never adds prices itself.

total_earn_asr_points.description: The sum of the booked rates' `earn_asr_points`. The gold "Members can earn up to … Pts for this stay!" banner. Optional; absent when no rate earns points.

voucher_code_valid.description: As T-04: with `voucherCode` only, whether upstream accepted it (`isCodeValid`). Optional.

rooms.description: The rooms booked, one per input `apartmentList` entry, in that order ("Room 1", "Room 2", …). Every one is bookable right now: a picked room + rate that is no longer available, or a room with nothing available, makes the call an error instead (ER-02, ER-04).

banner_image_url.description: T-04 `banner_image_url` of the room. Optional; the card's photo fallback.

rate.description: The booked rate, exactly as T-04 sends it: name, prices and taxes, points, refund flags, `is_member_rate`. The checkout link's `selectedRatePlanCode` is its `rate_plan_code`.

add_ons.description: Optional and RESERVED (user, 2026-10-28; README decision 5): the MVP's "Add-ons" row (Airport Transfer, Daily breakfast…), chosen on the ASR website. No upstream source is known yet; the widget hides the row until it is sent.

description.description: One line, e.g. "Breakfast AUD 17 nett per meal per person".
